Langley's known 55+ townhome stock is split across two municipalities, and the split decides the tax and suite rules: six of the seven known complexes are in the Township of Langley and one, Huntsfield Green, is in the City of Langley.

The Township depth is in Walnut Grove, not in the newer Willoughby stock: four of the seven complexes — Churchill Park, Spencer Green, Chartwell Green and Chelsea Green — are gated Walnut Grove townhouse complexes from the 1991 to 1993 era.

Willow Park Estates, 6467 197 Street (Willoughby, Township), is a townhouse complex built 1987 with 64 units; listings describe a 55+ community with at least one owner age 55 or older, a two-occupant maximum, a clubhouse and a recreation centre.
Churchill Park, 9208 208 Street (Walnut Grove, Township), is a gated 55+ complex of 147 two-storey duplex-style townhouses, freehold strata, built 1993.
Spencer Green, 21138 88 Avenue (Walnut Grove, Township), is a gated 55+ complex of 97 duplex-style townhomes, freehold strata, built 1991 by Polygon.

blocks.text: Langley 55+ Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The age rule on every complex above comes from the same provincial frame: under the Strata Property Act sections 123.1 and 123.2 a strata may restrict residents to age 55 or older, and any bylaw set below 55 has been invalid since November 24, 2022.

The bylaw restricts who may live in the townhouse, not who may own it: the Province states people under 55 can own a strata lot in a 55+ corporation but may not be able to reside in it, and the exemptions cover legacy residents, live-in caregivers, a younger spouse or partner, and defined children cases expanded on May 1, 2023.

Listing wording is not the bylaw: Willow Park Estates' "at least one owner must be 55" and Chelsea Green's "only one occupant to be 55+" are listing summaries, and the registered bylaw read with the Form B Information Certificate is what governs a purchase.

A long-term rental ban cannot be enforced in any of these complexes, because strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022 — an older "rentals not allowed" line in a building record for Willow Park Estates cannot be relied on; the tenant must still satisfy the 55+ bylaw or an exemption.

blocks.text: Langley 55+ Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The care option nearest the Walnut Grove complexes is rental, not ownership: Langley Seniors Village at 20363 65 Avenue in Willoughby is a registered assisted-living residence where Fraser Health records 64 publicly subsidized assisted-living units, accessed through Fraser Health rather than purchased.
Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the Fraser Health community hospital with 24/7 emergency serving both Langley municipalities.

Timms Community Centre, 20399 Douglas Crescent in the City of Langley, is the City's central recreation hub, sharing a building with Langley City Hall and the library, and the City runs seniors programming there — the municipal seniors venue nearest Huntsfield Green.

For a buyer who cannot use conventional transit without assistance, TransLink's HandyDART is a door-to-door, shared-ride service for people with a physical, sensory or cognitive disability who cannot navigate conventional transit for part or all of a trip, with trips available 7 days a week and the earliest pickup at 6 a.m.

For the one City of Langley complex, Huntsfield Green: the City's official 2026 rate sheet sets the total residential (Class 1) rate at $4.2067 per $1,000 of taxable value, made up of a $2.5937 general municipal rate, $1.1606 school, $0.3586 TransLink (GVTA), $0.0381 BC Assessment and $0.0555 Metro Vancouver (GVRD) and $0.0002 Municipal Finance Authority components.

The Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) applies in both municipalities: the Province lists Langley (city and township) as a taxable area, so a 55+ townhouse left vacant still requires the annual declaration.

Langley Centre, at Glover Road and Logan Avenue, is the bus exchange serving both municipalities, and the routes a 55+ townhouse buyer will use run from it: 320 to Surrey Central Station via downtown Cloverdale, 342 to Newton Exchange, 372 to Clayton Heights and 531 to Willowbrook and White Rock Centre.
HandyDART, TransLink's door-to-door shared-ride service, serves Langley for registered customers who cannot use conventional transit without assistance.

blocks.text: Langley 55+ Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Riparian and flood checks are parcel-level in this stock: for any complex near Bertrand Creek or another watercourse, confirm the setback and flood position for the specific unit with the Township in addition to the strata documents.

Age-restricted stock narrows the resale pool mechanically: the next buyer must also be able to live in the unit under the bylaw — be 55 or older, hold an exemption as a spouse, partner, caregiver or legacy resident, or buy without residing.

faq.q: My spouse is under 55 — can we both live in a 55+ townhouse in Langley?
faq.a: Yes, in a strata townhouse. Provincial rules require an exemption for a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement or holds a legacy exemption, and children can also be exempt in defined cases: a child under 19 in the resident's care, and an adult child the resident cared for before that child turned 19. The exemption comes from the Strata Property Regulation, so a complex's own bylaw cannot remove it.

faq.q: Is Chartwell Green the same as Chartwell Langley Gardens?
faq.a: No, and the shared name causes real search confusion in Walnut Grove. Chartwell Green at 8737 212 Street is a 55+ townhouse complex a buyer can purchase into. Chartwell Langley Gardens at 8888 202 Street is a Chartwell rental continuum-of-care residence that cannot be bought; Fraser Health records 92 long-term care beds there, of which 73 are publicly subsidized. Check the civic address and the tenure, not the Chartwell name.

faq.q: Where is the deepest choice of 55+ townhouses in Langley?
faq.a: Walnut Grove, in the Township. Four complexes sit there — Churchill Park (147 duplex-style townhouses, built 1993), Spencer Green (97 townhomes, built 1991), Chartwell Green and Chelsea Green — all gated, all ground-oriented, and all from the early 1990s. Willoughby, the Township's newer townhouse area, has only one 55+ complex, Willow Park Estates, and it was built in 1987, before the current Willoughby build-out.

faq.q: Can I buy a 55+ townhouse for my parent if I am under 55?
faq.a: Ownership itself is not age-restricted. The practical check is the registered bylaw and the exemptions in the strata package, because a listing's one-line age summary does not reproduce either.
